ami-bar-avin.name: Ami bar Avin
ami-bar-avin.bio: Amora quoted together with Rav Ḥananya bar Avin; Rabbeinu Gershom’s text of Keritot 20a names him Abaye bar Avin.
ami-bar-avin.prompt: A sage in his 40s with a short dark beard and a brown wool mantle, explaining a verse with an open hand to a companion beside him; background of a study hall with a scroll shelf, lit by an oil lamp.
